title: The Costly Reality of Put Hedging
text: I backtested put hedging for 19 and 1/2 years and the cost is absolutely brutal. What I did was look at spy and I looked at long puts with nine different variations. The purpose of the variations is to allow you to see how this thing behaves in different vastly different market conditions. Everything from 2007 to 2026, all of it. So, why long puts? Why the hedge? Well, it's because risk reduction sounds awesome. Who doesn't want to reduce their risk? It makes in complete sense. Something that pretty much all of us would want. The issue is insurance and risk reduction via a hedge can be very very expensive.
